b'# tinydl

A small command-line tool for downloading files from URLs.

## Usage

```
tinydl <url> [options]
```

## Command Line Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o, --output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q, --quiet` | no progress output |

## Examples

Download to stdout:
```
tinydl https://example.com/file
```

Download to a file:
```
tinydl https://example.com/file -o file
```

Download silently:
```
tinydl https://example.com/file -q
```
'
